descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
• Performs gage calibration for the measurement instruments for which there is in-house calibration capabilities;
• Selects and interacts with calibration vendors providing calibration services for manufacturing measurement instruments;
• Performs incoming inspection for designated parts. Fills out and files all the Vendor Corrective Action Requests for problems found in manufacturing;
• Participates in process improvement and scrap/rework reduction efforts throughout the manufacturing;
• Monitors the quality of vendor foundries as described in the quality system;
• Responsible for quality system documentation in his/her area. Facilitates compliance with procedures and work instructions
• Follow procedures according to ISO 9001 What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
